notes.title: For Beta Players only (Updates Dev 24)
notes.content: To the Curators and Beta players, today will be the last date of updates being applied until New Years weekend. I have a lot of stuff I want to add and I am going to wait until the weekend to add it to the Current game. If you went to the Casino before today, give it a try again! The slots will show an image now, and next update I will be adding a new game to the Casino. Thanks for playing everyone and hope your enjoying yourself. Merry Christmas everybody!

notes.title: Beta Players Only (Updates Dev 24)
notes.content: Curators and Beta Players, I have completed my update for the day and have implemented the first of the Steam achievements to PsyOps Solutions. Along with that, I have also added more enterable buildings, some more side quest, and a few more items. Hope you enjoy, and hope everyone is liking it. I will be adding more missions and items tomorrow. Thanks for your support everybody!

notes.title: For Beta Players only (Updates Dev 23)
notes.content: Curators and Beta players, sometime today (23 December) I will be adding steam achievements. If you are having problems running or playing the game it is because of this. This update will also add more locations on the map and some new side missions. Thank you all for taking the time to play!
